description.short: AI assistant that joins Teams meetings with a photoreal avatar.
description.full: Iris is an experimental AI meeting participant powered by Claude Sonnet 4.5 with a real-time photoreal avatar. Add Iris to a meeting and she will introduce herself (EU AI Act Article 50 disclosure), transcribe the conversation in real time, and respond when spoken to. Iris is not a production service — it is a research preview deployed by Contoso Ltd.

commands.title: Help
commands.description: Show what Iris can do in this meeting.
